name: nones-mcp-workspace
description: Bun Workspaces prototype and migration spec for the @nones MCP server suite

scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/core build && bun run --cwd adapters/journal build && bun run --cwd apps/kaiten build && bun run --cwd apps/opencode build && bun run --cwd apps/dsh build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/core typecheck && bun run --cwd adapters/journal typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/kaiten typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/opencode typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/dsh typecheck
scripts.test: bun run build && bun run test:unit
scripts.verify: bun run build && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test:unit && bun run pack:check
scripts.lint: bun run --cwd apps/kaiten lint && bun run --cwd apps/opencode lint
